title: 2-input line driver

sources.document: TI The Interface Circuits Data Book 2nd ed. 1974, SN75150 dual line driver (bulletin DL-S 7111428, Jan 1971)

pins.name: 1Y
pins.text: RS-232-C line output, swings about +/-5..8 V

functions.text: Datasheet positive logic Y = (AS)'. Inverting RS-232-C driver: output goes to the negative level when A and S are both high.

electrical.notes: VCC+ 10.8-13.2 V, VCC- -10.8 to -13.2 V, TA 0-70 C. Applied output voltage max +/-15 V (recommended); withstands short circuit to -25..+25 V. Output levels at RL 3-7 kohm: VOH min 5 V typ 8 V; VOL typ -8 V max -5 V. Inputs TTL/DTL: VIH 2 V, VIL 0.8 V, input voltage 0-5.5 V. Short-circuit current at VO 0 V: 15 mA (VI 3 V), -15 mA (VI 0 V) typical. Slew rate can be set with an external capacitor at the output.

timing.conditions: VCC+ 12 V, VCC- -12 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 7 kohm
VCC+ 12 V, VCC- -12 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 7 kohm

timingLimits.text: tTLH and tTHL at CL 2500 pF, RL 3-7 kohm: min 0.2 us, typ 1.4 us (tTLH) / 1.5 us (tTHL), max 2 us; at CL 15 pF, RL 7 kohm typ 40 ns (tTLH), 20 ns (tTHL)

unknown: Recommended IOL/IOH are not given (RS-232 line driver; output levels are given into 3-7 kohm instead).
Maximum propagation delays are not printed (typical only).
The datasheet's delay table does not say whether the A or the S input was switched.
notes: The ND symbol draws one driver (Y = NOT(A AND S)); the package holds two drivers sharing S.
